name: time
doc: Anything that happens in time. Each occurrence has an existence: an instant, or a span that starts at an instant and lasts a duration.

types.name: Moment
types.doc: A point in time as an ISO 8601 date-time string. The pattern checks the shape only, so a date that does not exist, such as 2026-02-30, still matches.

types.name: Instant
types.doc: An occurrence at a single moment.

types.name: Span
types.doc: An occurrence that starts at a moment and lasts a duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.doc: How long it lasts, counted from start. Zero is allowed and is not the same as an instant.

types.name: Existence
types.doc: When an occurrence is: either instantaneous, or a span with a duration.

types.name: Occurrence
types.doc: Anything that happens in time. Types that represent events, tasks, or other timed things extend this and inherit its existence.
